text: Brembo N.V. is listed on Euronext Milan; Nuova Fourb S.r.l. (Bombassei family) is the majority shareholder with 53.56% of ordinary shares and 81.06% of voting rights (shareholding structure as of 24 April 2026).
short: Brembo is listed in Milan; majority held by Nuova Fourb S.r.l. (Bombassei family).
